newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rugby union-Canterbury kill Free State's semi hopes.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Canterbury kill Free State's semi hopes.

text.p: Canterbury registered their first away victory in the Super 12 rugby series and killed Free State's chances of reaching the semifinals with a 16-11 victory on Saturday.
Canterbury moved into sixth place but cannot reach the final four after winning only four matches in their 10 outings.
Despite missing their experienced All Black half-back pairing of Andrew Mehrtens and Justin Marshall, full-back Daryl Lilley kept a steady head to guide the New Zealanders to victory.
